cards.card_text: Then the word asks, “For who has despised the day of small things?” Friend, my very first stamp looked like somebody SAT on the dough, and I'm STILL proud of it.
cards.verse_text: For who has despised the day of small things? But these seven eyes of the LORD, which scan the whole earth, will rejoice when they see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel.”
